title: High-Dimensional Asymptotics and Dataset Selection for Private Transfer Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.02578v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: To commit to buying external data or participate in collaborative learning, one must decide whether the additional data will improve prediction enough to justify the cost. This comes with several challenges: (i) the decision often relies only on aggregated statistics available publicly, rather than individual-level data; (ii) covariate and model shifts can induce negative transfer, so the additional data deteriorates rather than improves performance; (iii) if the data is sensitive, its privatization requires the injection of noise, which can also offset the benefit of a larger sample size. In this paper, we model the problem of dataset selection through high-dimensional regression with multiple heterogeneous sources and a weighted ridge estimator. Our approach uses only summary statistics and it gives privacy guarantees either on labels only or jointly on features and labels, in terms of $\rho$-zero-concentrated differential privacy. T

translated_title: 高维渐近理论与隐私保护迁移学习中的数据集选择
translated_abstract: 无论是购买外部数据还是参与协同学习，决策者都必须判断额外数据能否充分提升预测性能，从而证明其成本是合理的。这带来了几个挑战：(i) 决策通常只能依赖公开可得的聚合统计信息，而非个体层面的数据；(ii) 协变量偏移和模型偏移可能导致负迁移，使额外数据反而降低而非提升性能；(iii) 如果数据是敏感的，其隐私化处理需要注入噪声，这也可能抵消更大样本量带来的收益。本文通过具有多个异构数据源的高维回归以及加权岭估计器来建模数据集选择问题。我们的方法仅使用汇总统计信息，并能在 ρ-零集中差分隐私框架下，提供仅针对标签或同时针对特征与标签的隐私保证。
tldr: 本文针对隐私保护迁移学习中的数据集选择问题，提出了一种仅基于汇总统计量、采用加权岭估计器的多元异构源高维回归方法，在 ρ-零集中差分隐私保证下研究其高维渐近性质，以判断额外数据是否值得购买或纳入协同学习。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates dataset selection for private transfer learning as high-dimensional regression with multiple heterogeneous sources and a weighted ridge estimator, using only summary statistics and providing ρ-zero-concentrated differential privacy guarantees to determine whether additional data justifies its cost.
